subject: Payment hub cutoff & credit-trigger policy for Velum Health
content:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@velumhealth.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Pilot billing: cutoff times, credit ceiling, and VAT routing

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Finance asked me to pull together a single page with our ask so we can move the pilot forward:

- Requested net terms: Net 60 for pilot invoices (two invoices monthly).
- Temporary credit ceiling: EUR 120,000 for the first 90 days.
- Payment hub cutoff: We currently process outbound payments from our AP hub on Fridays at 15:00 CET; anything received after that lands in the next week. Can Redwood align invoice due-date handling to that cutoff so we don’t accrue unintended late flags?
- VAT routing: Velum is billing from an Irish entity (VAT IE1234567). We need invoice lines to show the VAT ID and indicate reverse-charge where applicable.

Attaching a suggested invoice cadence (spreadsheet) to illustrate timing.

Can you confirm whether the credit trigger (consumption > 75% of ceiling) would generate a soft hold (notify + payment request) or an invoice block? Also include any temporary early-pay discount if we move to Net 45.

Best,
Marta

--
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Velum Health
marta.ruiz@velumhealth.com

-----

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@velumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 10:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Pilot billing: cutoff times, credit ceiling, and VAT routing

Hi Marta,

Thanks — this is clear and very helpful. Quick responses inline: 

- Net terms: We can accommodate Net 60 for the pilot period. For production we typically default to Net 30/45 depending on credit checks.
- Credit ceiling: Temporary EUR 120k is doable; we will need the AR contact and a PO to lock the pilot.
- Payment hub cutoff: We can treat any payment received by our system before 17:00 CET on the invoice due date as same-day. To match your Friday 15:00 AP window, we propose an invoice due date that lands on Mondays to avoid the Friday processing gap (i.e., invoice due date = Monday + 7 days from issue). Will that work operationally?
- Credit trigger behavior: Our standard is a soft threshold notification at 75% (email to sales + finance) and a hard block at 95% requiring AR clearance. For pilots we can move the hard block to 100% with pre-agreed top-up workflow (e.g., immediate PO or advance payment).
- Early-pay discount: We can offer a 0.5% discount for Net 45 if you commit to a 90-day pilot and provide a PO covering the first two months.

I’m attaching our temporary credit form + a sample amendment we use for pilot billing (PDF). If you share the AR contact, VAT registration paperwork, and the signed PO we’ll spin up the account and annotate invoices with the VAT ID and reverse-charge notes.

Proposed next steps:
1) Velum sends signed PO to ar@redwoodinference.com (cc: kimberly)
2) Redwood issues first pilot invoice timed to your AP hub (we’ll set due dates to land on Monday)
3) Monitor consumption and notify at 75% and 95% thresholds; no hard block until you reach 100% during pilot

If that sounds good I’ll escalate to Legal for a short amendment and give you a target timeline.

Thanks,
Rohan

--
Rohan Mehta
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_temp_credit_form_20260615.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@velumhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 08:45:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Pilot billing: cutoff times, credit ceiling, and VAT routing

Thanks for the clarity Rohan. Quick addition from CS/ops:

- Onboarding timeline: Once PO & AR contact are in, ops will schedule the billing mapping within 3 business days.
- Reporting: We’ll provide a weekly consumption report each Tuesday so your finance team can see runway vs. credit ceiling.
- PO/AR: Marta — can you share the AR contact and preferred PO reference format? Also confirm if invoices should be addressed to Velum Health Limited (Ireland) or to a specific purchasing entity.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@velumhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Velum Health AR <ar@velumhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 15:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Pilot billing: cutoff times, credit ceiling, and VAT routing

Hi all,

Thanks — AR contact is Aoife Byrne (aoife.byrne@velumhealth.com). PO format is VEL-PO-[YYMM]-[####]. Please bill to: Velum Health Limited (Ireland), VAT IE1234567.

Attached is the signed PO for the first month (pdf). We confirm acceptance of the Net 60 pilot and the proposed Monday due date alignment. We would like the 0.5% Net 45 discount noted as an option if we move early to Net 45.

Marta

Attachments: velum_signed_PO_20260617.pdf

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@velumhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aoife Byrne <aoife.byrne@velumhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 16:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Pilot billing: cutoff times, credit ceiling, and VAT routing

Hi Marta / Aoife,

Great — thank you for the PO and the AR contact. Summary and action items on our side: 

- Agreed: Net 60 pilot, temporary credit ceiling EUR 120,000, weekly Tuesday consumption reports, due-date alignment to land on Monday in your AP cycle.
- Credit behavior: 75% notify (sales + finance), 100% hard block during pilot only after immediate AR clearance or advance payment; ops to implement soft notification thresholds in dashboard.
- VAT: Invoices will include Velum Health Limited (Ireland) + VAT IE1234567; reverse-charge wording will be added where applicable.
- Early-pay discount: 0.5% for Net 45 with 90-day commitment — optional and to be added to the amendment as a clause.

Next steps (target dates):
- 2026-06-21: Legal to send invoice amendment for signature (Marissa to coordinate).
- 2026-06-22: Ops to map billing cadence and tag account for pilot dashboard reporting.
- 2026-06-23: Redwood issues first pro forma invoice aligned to your Monday due-date.

Kimberly / Ops: please confirm when the amendment is drafted so I can route to Marta/Aoife.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot running.

Rohan

--
Rohan Mehta
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
